[[Empyreal Fragment]] is a crafting material needed to craft [[ascended weapon]]s and [[ascended armor|armor]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Gathered from ===
* Any [[chest]] in the open world, including [[jumping puzzle]] and [[mini-dungeon]] chests award from 2-9 Fragments. In most cases, characters must be level 80 to receive Empyreal Fragments from chests. Dungeons and some jumping puzzle chests (primarily those in level 80 zones, such as at [[Searing Ascent]]) award fragments regardless of level.

==== Guild missions ====
Players can get credit for one puzzle and one rush each week per account, with the week resetting on Saturday at midnight UTC.
;[[Guild Puzzle]]
Puzzle chests yield 6-9 fragments
* [[Angvar's Trove (guild puzzle)|Angvar's Trove]]
* [[Langmar Estate (guild puzzle)|Langmar Estate]]
* [[Proxemics Lab (guild puzzle)|Proxemics Lab]]
;[[Guild Race]]
* [[Bear Lope]] (10)
* [[Chicken Run]] (8-13)
* [[Devourer Burrow]] (8-9)
* [[Quaggan Paddle]] (7-13)
* [[Spider Scurry]] (12-13)
* [[Ghost Wolf Run]] (7-9)

==== Dungeons ====
* [[Dungeon]] explorable paths (20 for first and second completion per day, then [[diminishing returns]])
* [[Cracked Fractal Encryption]]s, obtained from [[Fractals of the Mists]] rewards (15 or 50)
** [[Volcanic Fractal]] - Magnificent Chest spawned by saving all the captives in the champion shaman fight (7-9)
